title: Higher OM stress matrix
objective: Extend the largest shared fail-closed higher-order OM and MaxMin boundary with exact scalable stress, lattice, certificate, and performance evidence

oracles: SageMath via /home/user/bin/sagelite: discriminants, index, and maximal-order basis
PARI/GP nfinit: discriminants and exact index
Hecke 0.39.21 at eab7e5566e56d8864fe9cd7b895811ab9df2fe32: discriminant, index, and basis matrix

handoff.summary: Extends the bounded binary OM lane to a nonlinear first residual sibling plus several terminal higher sides sharing a degree-raised representative. The GMN Section 5.5 degree-12 example now yields an inspectable three-branch type trace, exact index 39, deterministic terminal quotient selection, and a certified triangular lattice. CPython and Sage.js validate seven translated generators and reject corrupted basis/index evidence.
risks: The bounded higher residual coefficient map still supports only binary linear terminal residual factors of lattice length one.
Dynamic Sage.js OM is slower than the native maximal-overorder path on the new degree-12 case, so branched higher quotient trees remain explicitly ineligible for automatic selection.
next_steps: Generalize higher residual arithmetic to nonlinear extension fields and recursive representative refinement.
Source-transparently compile measured polynomial and closure-check loops before reconsidering automatic selection.
Run broad native and platform tiers after integration on main-1.
